articles.description: Bhadrapada Amavasya: Pithori Amavasya in 2026 will be observed on September 10, a significant day for mothers. Devotees will pray for their children's health and long life, ensuring family happiness. The observance is also linked to preserving family lineage and household peace. This festival, falling in Bhadrapada, involves worshipping Goddess Pithori and the Sapta Matrikas. Ancestor worship rituals are also performed, honoring deceased family members.

articles.title: Consider exempting Class 6 this year from 3-language policy: Supreme Court to CBSE
articles.description: The Supreme Court has recommended that the CBSE reconsider its three-language policy, particularly for Class 6 students. This policy requires students in Class 9 to learn two native Indian languages. The court has postponed the hearing regarding challenges to this policy until September 17, while Solicitor General Tushar Mehta indicated that the suggestion would be taken under advisement, citing concerns over implementation and necessary infrastructure.

articles.title: China’s Gen Z is going back to Mao: How economic slowdown & workplace stress are making youth look to the late leader for answers
articles.description: Mao Zedong's writings are captivating a fresh wave of audiences among the youth in China today. This resurgence is largely driven by economic struggles and heightened workplace stress. For many young individuals, Mao's philosophies serve as not just historical insights but as tools for resilience. The complexity of his legacy elicits both national pride and awareness of past hardships, reflecting the current societal dynamics within modern China.
